description: ExchangeRate-API provides foreign exchange rates for 160+ currencies. Developers authenticate with an API key and can fetch latest rates, pair conversion, and supported currency lists via REST endpoints. The keyed Free plan allows 1,500 requests per month and updates rates once per day; paid plans increase volume and unlock additional features.
resolution_notes: pricing.free_tier_limits: Auditor correct. Official pricing lists Free as API-key plan with 1.5K requests p/m (https://www.exchangerate-api.com/). Open Access is a separate no-key product at open.er-api.com with attribution and different IP throttling—not the 1,500/mo quota (https://www.exchangerate-api.com/docs/free). description: Auditor correct. Free quota is monthly (1.5K p/m); “once per day” is data update frequency, not a daily request limit (same two URLs). Status unchanged (operational).
